name: mupad
description: A friendly Python learning app for iPad, Windows and Linux. Learn step by step, practise with coding exercises, and run real Python offline.

scripts.check: node --check core.mjs && node --check www/app.js && node --check www/python-worker.js && node --check www/python-runner.mjs && node --check scripts/bundle.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-native.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.build:desktop: npm run bundle && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --publish never

author: MuPad contributors
